name: decide
description: Present a decision matrix with options and evaluation criteria. Use when the human needs to weigh tradeoffs between 2-5 options. Cognitive op: decide.

description.description: Context for why this decision matters now

mode.description: 'select' shows option cards for a single pick. 'score' shows a matrix grid for scoring each option per criterion.

criteria.description: Required when mode is 'score'; optional context bullets when mode is 'select'.

scale_steps.description: Score-mode only. Number of points on the per-cell rating scale.
